evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full intake was done, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern ('some of it may be going to storage... I guess that would be extra') but the rep pivoted straight into handling the storage logistics rather than digging into the underlying worry about added cost.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: The estimate-variability framing landed clearly ('that's not really the minimum, that's an estimate based on the information you've shared, possible that it's going to be less than that or more') but no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, and no self-prep tip.

top_strength: Exceptional patience across a long, meandering 32-minute call with an elderly returning customer who struggled with hearing and communication — never once showed frustration and re-explained cleanly every time.
coaching_note: When she flagged the storage add-on as a cost worry, that was the moment to go two layers deep before moving on to logistics — instead the rep answered the immediate ask and never circled back to reassure her on the cost question specifically.
